page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is an x86_64 cloud server instance built on the KVM hypervisor platform. It equips 32 dedicated vCPUs backed by 16 physical Intel Xeon 8163 cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz with two threads per core. System memory is provisioned at 64.0 GB RAM, yielding 2.0 GB per vCPU for a compute-focused vCPU-to-memory allocation. Local NVMe storage is not bundled with this instance type. Network connectivity provides a baseline network throughput of 6 Gbps. Vector and execution capabilities include instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512F, AES cryptography, and FMA.

Performance data indicates a distinct contrast between single-threaded and multi-threaded execution metrics. Single-core performance falls into lower testing tiers, marked by a stress-ng single-core score of 1109.99 and a Geekbench single-core score of 960.0. In contrast, multi-threaded CPU results align with average server benchmarks, producing a Geekbench multi-core score of 8426.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 22982.48. Memory bandwidth reaches 74.54 GB/sec for uncached 256MB block reads and 34.35 GB/sec for large block writes.

By omitting integrated local storage, the instance maintains a targeted hardware profile suited for workloads relying on block storage attachments or decoupled storage architectures. The ecs.sn1.7xlarge offers cost efficiency for applications requiring moderate memory density alongside 32 parallel processing threads. Suitable workloads include multi-threaded batch operations, software compilation (scoring 18724.0 in Geekbench clang compilation), Redis key-value stores (achieving 23.27 million SET operations per second), and static web serving.
